explanation: The value peaks at D1 when the previous trial was unrewarded, usually 7-10 and almost always 9-10 on a second loss in a row, but only about 1 on some first losses that follow rewarded trials; D1 after a rewarded trial is 0-1. GO is a middling 2-5 (about 4-5 after a loss or when choosing a1, 1-3 after a reward with a2), and D2 is 0-2 after a2 or reaching S2 but 3-7 after a1 to S1 common or during a loss streak, with everything lower (mostly 0-2) in the first ~30 trials.
